avis.texte: Es solo agua miscelar, pero para la cara me va muy bien, es la segunda vez que compro.
Il pacco è arrivato puntuale e ben imballato. Prodotto ottimo per la pulizia del visto e per struccarsi. Acquisto super consigliato!

So, I bought this product after my visit to dermatologist. I have an oily sensitive and acne prone skin and I used to remove the make up with a common micellar water by Garnier. That product was pretty good for my face but the Aderma micellar water is way more effective with my acne. It removes all the extra oil from my skin without damaging the dry areas around my nose and my chin. At the beginning though, I have to admitt that I used to feel a sense of dryness and redness which only lasted for a few minutes during the first month of applying it. After the first month my skin begun to adjust in the product and the dryness and redness stopped being pressent. The usual pimples got reduced and eventually got vanished for an accountable amount of time. The only acne I get now is because of period which I can't help and that's ok. Generally I am really satisfied by this product and I am glad my dermatologist recommended it. However, I need to say that it takes a bit more of product (than other micellar water) in my cotton pads to remove my foundation completely and the foundation I use is a light one, so here is a place for improvement! Finally, every skin is diffent with their unique needs and this is why i strongly encourage people to consult their doctor first. What works in one's skin doesn't necesarily mean that works in everyone's skin! Last but not least, I believe that a light hydrating serum is ideal to be combined with this micellar water
